products.name: Prayerly
products.headline: How one call becomes
products.line: A neighbor calls. The AI makes sure they're safe, listens, and hands them to a volunteer from the church. The volunteer prays, taps how it went, and the church follows up with one kind text.

steps.title: A neighbor calls the prayer line
steps.body: They call from the church's ad or a text they were sent. Every church shares one Prayerly brand, and the ads are ours to make.
steps.decided: One Prayerly ad brand for every church (Nov 5)

steps.title: Asks the safety question first
steps.say: I'm here with you. Before we talk, are you in danger right now, or worried you might hurt yourself or someone else?
steps.body: Every call starts here. The AI never decides on its own whether a call is a crisis. The caller's answer decides.

steps.title: Connects them to the crisis line, and the pastor is alerted
steps.body: A crisis caller never reaches a volunteer. The AI connects them to the crisis line and the pastor gets a text alert.
where: Prayerly - Crisis alert to the pastor

steps.title: "How can we pray for you today?"
steps.say: How can we pray for you today?
steps.body: It listens, asks one or two short questions at most, and reflects one real detail back. It never prays itself.
steps.decided: The AI never prays and never names the church (Nov 4)

steps.title: Saves the need, asks: a man or a woman?
steps.say: So I can connect you with the right person, would you be more comfortable talking with a man or a woman?
steps.body: It saves the prayer need in one or two plain sentences, in the caller's own terms, to their contact record.
steps.decided: Callers are matched by gender only (Nov 4)

steps.title: A heads-up text, then {line} rings
steps.body: Just before the phone rings, the volunteer gets a text so they know who they're praying with. Up to 10 volunteers ring at once; the first to answer gets the call.

steps.title: Answers in the app and prays
steps.body: Volunteers answer inside the SmartFunnels Pro app, on a computer or a phone, never on their personal number. The call shows as a Prayerly call, not a stranger's number.
steps.decided: Volunteers only pray. ChurchReady does the inviting (Oct 22)

steps.title: Taps how it went: {outcome}
steps.body: One tap after hanging up. The four outcomes are the only choices.

steps.title: One thank-you text, with the church's plan-a-visit page
steps.imgCap: The church's plan-a-visit page (Quick save), shown with a sample church
steps.body: Only callers who agreed to texts get it. One text, never a sequence. The link opens the church's plan-a-visit page, so the pastor knows who's coming Sunday.
steps.decided: Plan a Visit becomes a tab in the Prayerly church app (Nov 5)

steps.title: Gets a link to note why
card: A link to the caller's record
steps.body: No marketing goes out. The reason shows up in the church's report.

steps.title: Gets what they need to call back
steps.body: No marketing goes out. The volunteer calls the person back.

steps.title: Sees it in the Pastor Report
steps.body: Caller names and outcomes, never phone numbers or prayer content.
